title: Butchie and the pool games
summary: A fragmentary anecdote about Butchie, pool and a coolness between them.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong

blocks.x: So from then on I used to always challenge him to play pool. Either one of us couldn't play. And we used to get a kick out of playing each other. In fact that's what I felt. And so from then on I'd never asked him to play pool. He must have felt something was wrong. He never asked me and I never asked him to play pool.
Then what happened is that night that all of us would be through here until I met him. Get that finish up. Yeah so Butchie.
After Butchie told me he didn't want me to say nothing to him and Joe told me, well what are you going to do Butchie? I'm not going to do anything. He said man, I'm a bad guy.
